name: Lesbians R Us
source:
College life is never easy. But when your a girl in love with your two best friends, it's even harder.  Will you be able to ignite the flame of yuri love within them, or be a weird loner forever?

[From [url=https://thecrimsonnight.itch.io/lesbians-r-us]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
大学生活从来不轻松。但身为女生，又爱上两位最好的朋友，情况就更加艰难了。你能否在她们心中点燃百合之情，还是会永远成为一个古怪的独行者？
